mutant.description: The load-bearing assertion of this act is that the LIVE default-version document of each policy equals its repo file. An equality comparator that always returns True reads identically to a correct one on a passing case, so the comparator itself was mutated: the SAME code path was re-run against a deepcopy of each repo document with one Sid renamed to <Sid>_PLANTED_MUTANT.
mutant.expected: EQUAL=False for both policies against the mutated copies, while the unmutated comparison reads EQUAL=True -- that is, the comparator discriminates
mutant.observed: Unmutated: cloudops-dell-agent-deploy-policy EQUAL=True (11 vs 11 statements), cloudops-dell-agent-create-policy EQUAL=True (6 vs 6). Mutated, same comparator: EQUAL=False for BOTH. The mutant fired, so the True results are a test result rather than a tautology.
